_readme: Exported `use*` hooks that no component renders, which check-unrendered-hooks.mjs must not fail on.
THIS FILE HAS NO ENTRIES, AND THAT IS THE POINT. An entry here is a debt, not an absolution. Add
one only for a hook that is genuinely and deliberately unrendered, and say which kind of not-a-gap
it is. Do not add an entry to make the gate quiet.
WHY THIS GATE EXISTS. `check-dormant-rpcs.mjs` asks whether a database function has a caller.
Satisfying it turned out not to mean the capability was reachable: a hook that calls the RPC, that
no component renders, is a capability with no way in -- and the dormant-RPC gate passes, because
the RPC does have a caller. That caller is simply unreachable itself. The branch that added the
dormant-RPC gate proved the point by introducing one: `useAddAppointmentPreparationItem` was
written, its screen was not, and the gate reported zero.
THIRTY-THREE HOOKS HAD NO RENDERER, and all thirty-three are resolved (BACKLOG.md G16). Sixteen
were not debt and are deleted -- three unadopted helpers with no caller anywhere (`useIsMobile`,
`useServerListState`, `useBulkAction`), and thirteen whose job a rendered sibling already did, or
whose stated purpose was served another way entirely. Seventeen were real gaps and every one now
has a surface.
Two of the gate's own readings were wrong and were fixed rather than worked around: a hook declared
beside the component that used it read as unreachable, and hooks vouched for by nothing but a stale
comment read as reachable. Blanking comments before the scan is what exposed `useUpdateCourseVersion`,
which a comment in `useCompetencies.ts` had been covering for.
Four entries started life here as recorded gaps and turned out on inspection not to be gaps at all:
`useLogResidentChangeOfCondition` (a richer rendered dialog writes the same row plus the event, the
follow-up and the history), `useIssueCertificate` (issuance moved inside `complete_course_assignment`
so a failed request could not leave a completion with no certificate), and the two whole-table
notification reads whose deep-link and report purposes are both served another way. Reading the
successor before building changed the answer every time, as it did for G15.13 and G15.15.
